caption: The drawing depicts a seated woman positioned in the left-center, wearing a red and orange striped skirt, a light pink or peach blouse, a blue headscarf, and a black waist sash. She is holding a gray-and-white striped object that rests on her lap. To her right, there are three birds resembling geese or ducks, colored in shades of pale yellow, green, and white, with small touches of red on their beaks. Behind the birds and the woman, there is dense foliage in green and brown tones, with tall grass or reeds in the background. On the left side, the background contains large blue and red flowers with green leaves. The entire composition is set against a brown background, with more subtle touches of blue, yellow, and green throughout to depict the plants and ground. The drawing is rectangular and sits on a cream-colored paper mat, and the artist's name appears to be signed in the bottom left corner.
title: Tapestry
